matrix_name.name: ethylene-vinyl acetate copolymer
matrix_name.description: Chemically crosslinked EVA foam framework (trade name Elvax 460; VA content 18 wt%); porous structure made using NaCl sacrificial template; sample label El2 (EVA:NaCl = 1:12).

fillers.name: polypyrrole
fillers.description: PPy coating deposited by vapor phase polymerization (VPP); sample label El2P1 indicates polymerization time 1 h.

fillers.name: silver
fillers.description: Ag nanoparticles grown by electroless silver plating on PPy-coated EVA foam; AgNO3 concentration 20 mg/mL; sample label El2P1A20. Reported AgNP loading (by mass method) 51.95 wt% (basis relative to composite not explicitly clarified).
